title: Flash or Pro LLM for cold email? We ran 25 A/B tests over 125,000 emails
excerpt: Every AI vendor sells a cheap Flash tier and a pricier Pro tier. We ran both on 125,000 cold emails and priced every outcome: our best Pro workflow buys a positive reply for $139, our best Flash workflow a website visit for $1, and the winner beats its own tier's average. Ten cuts, Flash against Pro, plus what the industry measured.
